sidecar_ride.about: The man in the plain motorcycle's sidecar (rider.2), seated low, legs forward in the tub: his right forearm on the tub's rim, his left hand on his thigh, looking about; his rifle put away.

jeep_gunner.about: The Jeep's gunner standing behind the post, knees bent to the low gun and leaning into it, both hands on its grips (grip.gunner.l and .r), looking along it and about, the ride in his knees; his rifle slung on his back. Root: the gunner socket (his feet); the game turns him with the gun's mount (mg_mount) if it turns.

car_drive.about: A car's driver: both hands on the wheel at a quarter to three (grip.driver.l and .r: which is which is taken from where they are), his feet on the pedals, the body taking the ride, his eyes on the road with a glance to each side; his rifle put away. Seat 0.32 over the floor his boots are on. Fitted to the Jeep and the GAZ67's wheel.

car_drive_b.about: A car's driver: both hands on the wheel at a quarter to three (grip.driver.l and .r: which is which is taken from where they are), his feet on the pedals, the body taking the ride, his eyes on the road with a glance to each side; his rifle put away. Seat 0.34 over the floor his boots are on. Fitted to the Kubelwagen and the Fiat508's wheel.

car_drive_c.about: A car's driver: both hands on the wheel at a quarter to three (grip.driver.l and .r: which is which is taken from where they are), his feet on the pedals, the body taking the ride, his eyes on the road with a glance to each side; his rifle put away. Seat 0.34 over the floor his boots are on. Fitted to the FieldCar and the Kurogane's wheel.

car_ride.about: A man in a car's front seat: sat back, his rifle stood on its butt between his boots and both hands on it, the body taking the ride, looking out to the side and ahead. Seat 0.33 over the floor.

car_ride_back.about: A man in a car's back seat: sat back, his rifle stood on its butt between his boots and both hands on it, the body taking the ride, looking out to the side and ahead. Seat 0.38 over the floor.

bike_astride.about: A motorcycle's rider astride the saddle: hands on the bars (grip.driver.l and .r), boots on the footrests (foot.l and .r), leaning to the bars, the body taking the ride, a glance to each side; his rifle slung on his back. Fitted to the R75, the M72, the M20, the Alce, the Motorcycle.

bike_astride_b.about: A motorcycle's rider astride the saddle: hands on the bars (grip.driver.l and .r), boots on the footrests (foot.l and .r), leaning to the bars, the body taking the ride, a glance to each side; his rifle slung on his back. Fitted to the WLA, the Rikuo.

bike_pillion.about: The man on the R75's pillion, astride: his hands on the grab handle ahead of him, his boots on his rests, looking about over his shoulders; his rifle slung on his back.

bike_pillion_b.about: The man on the M72's pillion, astride: his hands on the grab handle ahead of him, his boots on his rests, looking about over his shoulders; his rifle slung on his back.

bike_pillion_c.about: The man on the Rikuo's pillion, astride: his hands on the saddle's springs ahead of him, his boots on his rests, looking about over his shoulders; his rifle slung on his back.

bike_pillion_d.about: The man on the Alce's pillion, astride: his hands on the second saddle's own bars, his boots on his rests, looking about over his shoulders; his rifle slung on his back.

sidecar_gunner.about: The sidecar's gunner seated low on his cushion, his legs forward in the tub, both hands on the gun's grips (grip.gunner.l and .r), looking along it and about; his rifle put away. Fitted to the M72 and the Rikuo; the game turns him with the gun's mount if it turns.

sidecar_gunner_b.about: The sidecar's gunner seated low on his cushion, his legs forward in the tub, both hands on the gun's grips (grip.gunner.l and .r), looking along it and about; his rifle put away. Fitted to the R75; the game turns him with the gun's mount if it turns.

die_seat_slump.about: A car's driver killed in his seat: struck back, his hands slide off the wheel and he folds forward over his lap and to his left, his head hanging; the last pose held. Played from the drivers' clips (car_drive, car_drive_b, car_drive_c).

die_ride_slump.about: A man killed in a car's seat with his rifle stood between his knees: struck back, his hands let the rifle go and it tips forward against what is ahead of him; he slumps forward and to his right, his head hanging. Played from car_ride and car_ride_back (fitted at the front seat's 0.33: in the back seat his boots stay 0.05 over the floor).

die_bike_slump.about: A motorcycle's rider killed astride: struck back, then slumped forward over the tank and to his left, his hands off the bars and hanging, still astride; the last pose held (the bike's own fall is the vehicle's). Played from bike_astride and bike_astride_b.

die_pillion_slump.about: The pillion killed: struck back, he sags back and to his right, his hands off the handle, then his head drops forward; still astride, the last pose held. Played from bike_pillion .. bike_pillion_d.

die_sidecar_slump.about: A man killed in the sidecar: struck back against the backrest, his hands off the gun, he slumps to his right against the tub's side, his head hanging; the last pose held. Played from sidecar_gunner, sidecar_gunner_b and sidecar_ride.

die_gunner_slump.about: The Jeep's gunner killed at the gun: struck back off its grips, his knees give and he drops back onto the back seat behind him, slumped there with his head on his chest; the last pose held.
